sloka: शयनीयं नरेन्ध्रस्य तदसाद्य व्यतिष्ठत ।सोऽत्यासाद्य तु तद्वेश्म तिरस्करिणि मन्त्रा ॥२-१५-२१॥
transliteration: śayanīyaṁ narendhrasya tadasādya vyatiṣṭhata ।so'tyāsādya tu tadveśma tiraskariṇi mantrā ॥2-15-21॥

translations.english: Having approached the king's bedchamber Sumatra stood behind the screen, singing his glory and seeking the blessings (of God) on this son of Raghus dynasty.
